leaders.name: Odette Marr

scene.title: A Name to Live Up To
scene.setting: the Dunmere quarry gate at dusk, the work horn sounding over a flooded pit. Odette checks a ledger with a lantern.
lines: "Hold this. No, the other way up. Nobody reads that ledger the right way up and lives."
"My family cut this hill for three generations. The name is on every wall in town."
"You carry a name too. People look at you and see Hartwell, or Aurelian, or whoever they need."
"I left with one Rhyhorn and a bad attitude. It worked out. Mostly."
"Do I tell you the name is a weight, or a tool?"

choices.label: Both.
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6. She turns mentor: ally flag `odette_mentor`; Reluctant Hero event (quarry Alpha) becomes eligible

choices.label: Hand back the ledger without a word
choices.outcome: Respect +6

choices.label: A name is only a name.
choices.outcome: Respect -5, Suspicion +10; she gets curt for the Gym fight

leaders.pre: Show me the person, not the family.
leaders.win: Take the badge. Don't hang it where people can read it.
leaders.lose: Names make people careless. Come back when you aren't.
leaders.badgeStory: the Quarry Mark is the unsigned chisel mark she cut into the first block she quarried alone.
leaders.conflict: Walked away from a mining dynasty and sees it in the player
leaders.hook: A Name to Live Up To; The Reluctant Hero (a quarry Alpha)

leaders.name: Wick Aldersey

scene.title: The Lantern Vigil
scene.setting: the empty square of Hallow Marrow after the last tour, one lantern still unlit by the well.
lines: "Tour is over. You can stay, if you can stay quiet."
"Every night one lantern stays lit for whoever the well took. I never asked the name."
"Dusknoir keeps me company. It is a good listener. It has to be, it cannot talk."
"Nobody asks me to dinner. They ask me to light things."

choices.label: Hold the lantern until dawn
choices.outcome: Trust +10 (kept a promise to stay), Affection +6; unlocks the Duskull Remembrance flag

choices.label: Ask whose name it is
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6; he shares a Lore entry on the Long Night

choices.label: Leave quickly
choices.outcome: Trust -3, no flag

leaders.pre: Welcome to the show. It's quieter than I make it sound.
leaders.mid: Oh. You're good company, even in here.
leaders.win: Take the lamp. It means someone stayed.
leaders.lose: Another quiet night. Come back and stay a while.
leaders.badgeStory: the Vigil Lamp is the lantern he lit the first night he stayed.
leaders.conflict: Runs lantern tours and goes home to an empty house
leaders.hook: The Lantern Vigil arc (unlocks the Duskull Remembrance)

leaders.name: Sigrid Holloway

scene.title: The Unexpected Mentor
scene.setting: Dunmere Lake at dawn, ice thick enough to stand a drill on. Sigrid is already there, over-prepared.
lines: "I was going to practice alone. Not because I'm nervous. Because the ice is exclusive."
"You hesitate on the switch. It costs you two turns. I counted. Do you want the drill?"
"Mamoswine does the work. The cold does the work. I just stand here and look prepared."

choices.label: Take the 3-turn drill
choices.outcome: Scripted drill; a one-battle bonus (+1 first-switch speed); Respect +8

choices.label: Say "You're better than the cold.
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6; she loses her pre-battle overexplaining

choices.label: Decline
choices.outcome: No change

leaders.pre: Don't take it personally if I'm good.
leaders.mid: I counted. You're ahead, and I'm not counting anymore.
leaders.win: Okay. That was good. I'll say it once.
leaders.lose: I told you. It wasn't the cold. Or was it.
leaders.badgeStory: the First Ice is the thin ice on the lake that held her weight at age eight.
leaders.conflict: Believes the cold makes her good, not her

leaders.name: Tam Rourke

scene.title: The Training Yard
scene.setting: the Greywick training yard. Tam, reading a pamphlet on modern mechanics, hides it under a mat.
lines: "Stance first. Everything else is fashion."
"That pamphlet? A student left it. I confiscated it. I have read it twice."
"Machop don't care about fashion. They care about whether you show up."
"Tell anyone, and the next drill is a hundred of the same kick."

choices.label: Ask about the pamphlet
choices.outcome: Trust +8; he teaches a modern move lesson; the Machop Remembrance becomes eligible

choices.label: Pretend you did not see
choices.outcome: Affection +5

choices.label: Tease him
choices.outcome: Respect -5; he does extra drills in the Gym

leaders.pre: Stand properly or do not stand at all.
leaders.mid: Hm. Newer than my teaching. Still good.
leaders.win: Take the badge. And never mention the pamphlet.
leaders.badgeStory: the Standing Stone is a stone from Greywick moor, because standing still is a move.
leaders.conflict: Dismisses new mechanics but is secretly fascinated

leaders.name: Vesper Lindgren

scene.title: The Trade
scene.setting: the Hallow Marrow night market, a ribbon stall under pale lanterns. Vesper holds a pink ribbon too long.
lines: "Don't look at the ribbon. Look at the weasels. They're terrifying."
"Dark is what I am good at. It is not what I like."
"There is a Fairy Pokémon I raised in secret. Nobody in town knows."
"If I trusted you, I might trade it to you. Just so it has a home that says yes."

choices.label: Buy her the matching ribbon (Affection 60 or higher: she offers the trade)
choices.outcome: Affection +5; a permanent or temporary trade of a Fairy Pokémon

choices.label: Keep her secret
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6; ask again at Affection 60

choices.label: Tease her
choices.outcome: Affection -5, Trust -3

leaders.pre: I'm good. I'll be unpleasant about it.
leaders.mid: I smiled. Don't write it down.
leaders.win: Take the badge. Don't ask what the petal is.
leaders.lose: Dark wins. Don't look so sad. It's what I'm good at.
leaders.badgeStory: the Duskpetal is a black petal edged in pink, her own design.
leaders.conflict: Wants to be a Fairy specialist

leaders.name: Dunstan Kell

scene.title: The Leader's Request
scene.setting: a Greywick dig camp, a cage door open and empty.
lines: "Drilbur is gone. A young one. It left a hole behind, so at least it's tidy."
"I lost four matches in a row. I think it left because it expected a win."
"Can you help? It's two nodes of the moor. I'd go, but if I fail again I'd rather not be seen."

choices.label: Accept the 2-node quest
choices.outcome: Complete: Trust +15 (saved them from worry), Affection +10; Drilbur is an ally; a key item

choices.label: Promise to look "when you can
choices.outcome: Trust +10 if kept, Trust -20 if broken

choices.label: Tell him to rest
choices.outcome: Affection +5

leaders.mid: I felt that. I remember that feeling.
leaders.win: I'll take it. Drilbur will be pleased.
leaders.badgeStory: the Deep Seam is a vein he struck on the last dig he led.
leaders.conflict: Fears he is no longer good enough
leaders.hook: The Leader's Request (a missing digger Pokémon)

leaders.name: Captain Tolliver Brisk

scene.title: The Storm Crossing
scene.setting: the ferry deck in a squall, rope knots whipping. Tolliver ties a knot with his teeth.
lines: "Hold the line. Not the rope. The line. The rope is for panic."
"Sixty-six years. Three offers of a successor. Three no's, and all three good people."
"There is a friend in Halvard Row who has promised to retire when I do. We play chess by mail. I keep losing."

choices.label: Hold the line through the storm
choices.outcome: Trust +10 (a promise kept), Respect +8; ally flag `tolliver_crossing`

choices.label: Ask about a successor
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6; unlocks Bramble's chess pact scene

choices.label: Step back from the wheel
choices.outcome: Trust -3

leaders.pre: Anchor down. Let's see what holds.
leaders.mid: Hm. That was a clean knot.
leaders.win: Take the knot, then. Don't tie it too tight.
leaders.lose: Sea has no mercy. Neither do I. Try again.
leaders.badgeStory: the Ferry Knot is the guild knot meaning "this crossing is safe".
leaders.conflict: Needs a successor and has refused three
leaders.hook: A storm crossing; the retirement chess pact with Bramble

leaders.name: Lark Ostrander

scene.title: The Ace Arc
scene.setting: the Lanternreach rooftop at wind-up, signal flags snapping. Tempestwing perches on a mast far from Lark.
lines: "It sits over there. It has always sat over there lately."
"It has outgrown me. I am the weather forecast it ignores."
"If I ask it to stay, I make it a cage. If I don't, I make it a goodbye."

choices.label: Tell her to ask it directly
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6; the storm flight event unlocks

choices.label: Offer to fly with her
choices.outcome: Affection +10; an event where she flies the player over the Reach

choices.label: Tell her it is only a bird
choices.outcome: Affection -5, Trust -3

leaders.pre: It's not that I don't trust her. It's that she doesn't need me.
leaders.mid: It stayed. It stayed for this. I'm going to cry.
leaders.win: You earned the flag. Fly it well.
leaders.lose: Not this time. It was a good gust though.
leaders.badgeStory: the Signal Flag is the flag for "come home", flown from Lanternreach in storms.
leaders.conflict: Her Ace has outgrown her and she fears being left

leaders.name: Anneliese Kroll

scene.title: The Sealed Envelope
scene.setting: a Brineholt generator shed, a sealed envelope under a wrench.
lines: "A nurse once said I should find someone I can trust. I said I'd start with the wrench."
"Inside is evidence. League things. It can't go to the League."
"Take it to the drop in Meridian. A woman named Halima Fenn. Don't read it. I know you want to."

choices.label: Deliver it unopened
choices.outcome: Trust +15, Loyalty +10; opens the Integrity Bureau questline

choices.label: Read it first and tell her
choices.outcome: Trust -3; she respects the honesty (Respect +6)

choices.label: Read it and hide it
choices.outcome: Caught: Trust -25, Suspicion +20

leaders.pre: I would tell you what I know, but you wouldn't believe it.
leaders.mid: Hm. Your Pokémon are not following orders. They're making them.
leaders.win: Take the badge. Keep your head down.
leaders.lose: The grid holds. Now go home and think.
leaders.badgeStory: the Open Circuit has a gap, a promise to close it when the truth is public.
leaders.conflict: Has evidence and no one to trust
leaders.hook: The Leader's Request (gather evidence for the Integrity Bureau)

leaders.name: Mirabel Quince

scene.title: Press Day
scene.setting: the Brineholt quay at noon, a live cooking show under a striped awning, cameras up.
lines: "Ladies and gentlemen, and one Trainer. Tonight, a dish that bites back!"
(backstage) Mirabel: "The smile is armor. The armor is my best dish."
"I haven't eaten alone in years. A crowd is not company. It's a wall."

choices.label: Play along on stage
choices.outcome: Respect +6; a World News headline names the player

choices.label: Skip the show and meet her backstage
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6; she drops her act

choices.label: Mock the show
choices.outcome: Respect -5, Affection -5

leaders.pre: Everyone wants a photo. Nobody asks my name.
leaders.mid: Oh, you're quick. That's good television.
leaders.win: A standing ovation for you. I mean it.
leaders.badgeStory: the Curtain Call is the pin she wears the night the lights go out.
leaders.hook: A public cooking show; the Press Day

leaders.name: Rhodri Vale

scene.title: The Dragonair Rescue
scene.setting: a Lanternreach sea cave, a Dragonair caught in a snare knotted a way Rhodri knows.
lines: "This knot is a Vale knot. I taught it to one student."
"Keep the Dragonair still. It will not bite. It will only wish to."
"If it is her, I will have to decide what kind of teacher I was."

choices.label: Hold the Dragonair while he cuts
choices.outcome: Trust +15, Affection +10 (saved them); at Trust 70 the Dratini Remembrance unlocks

choices.label: Offer to look into the student
choices.outcome: Trust +8; unlocks a poaching arc

choices.label: Suggest it was an accident
choices.outcome: Respect -5

leaders.pre: Dragons are older than your regret. They don't hold grudges, but they keep count.
leaders.win: The oath is yours. Don't make it lighter.
leaders.badgeStory: the Scale Oath is a scale given only to those who hold a promise.
leaders.conflict: Suspects a former student of poaching
leaders.hook: A Dragonair rescue (Dratini Remembrance at Trust 70)

leaders.name: Perpetua Ashby

scene.title: The Family Confrontation
scene.setting: the Port Lathe quay, a black carriage with a family crest. Perpetua pulls up her hood.
lines: "That crest is mine. I mean, it was. I'd rather you didn't look at it."
"I left everything to be here. Please don't waste my time."
(her brother steps out) Brother: "Perpetua. Father is asking."
"Tell Father the name was Ashby. The person is Perpetua."

choices.label: Stand beside her
choices.outcome: Respect +6, Loyalty +6 (defended in public)

choices.label: Step between them and say she is a Leader here
choices.outcome: Trust +8, Affection +6; the family backs off for now

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.outcome: No change

leaders.pre: I left everything to be here. Please don't waste my time.
leaders.mid: My family would say I'm too gentle. Watch.
leaders.win: Take the thistle. It holds when roses don't.
leaders.lose: Not today. But I'm still here.
leaders.badgeStory: the Thistle Seal replaces the family rose she gave up.
leaders.conflict: Left a noble family and is hiding it

leaders.name: Dr. Linnea Oyelaran

scene.title: The Strategy Lesson
scene.setting: a Meridian lecture hall after hours, a whiteboard of battle diagrams.
lines: "This is going to be a very informative loss. For you."
"May I log your next battle? For science. Every turn, every choice."
"I do not ask what the experiment costs. I should. I have decided to start with you."

choices.label: Consent to the log
choices.outcome: Trust +8; a strategy lesson (a small battle bonus); a research log in the Journal

choices.label: Ask about cost
choices.outcome: Affection +6, Respect +6; she begins to see the cost

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: Trust -3; the Gym team is unchanged

leaders.pre: This is going to be a very informative loss. For you.
leaders.mid: Interesting. That was outside the model.
leaders.win: Reported. The hypothesis was wrong. I am pleased.
leaders.badgeStory: the Hypothesis is a badge awarded for an idea that failed well.
leaders.conflict: Treats every battle as an experiment and ignores what it costs
leaders.hook: The Unexpected Mentor (a strategy lesson); research events

leaders.name: Gaspard Orme

scene.title: The Quiet Admission
scene.setting: his Meridian office, a League seal on the desk and a ledger he keeps closing.
lines: "The League has its reasons. I say that a great deal."
"Blissey heals people. I have not healed this."
"Three matches I have refereed felt wrong. I have asked nobody. I am asking you. Is that wrong?"

choices.label: Offer to look at the ledger
choices.outcome: Trust +10; the Gilt Circle hint unlocks; ally flag `gaspard_doubt`

choices.label: Tell him to go to the Bureau
choices.outcome: Respect +6

choices.label: Say it is not your business
choices.outcome: Trust -3

leaders.mid: Please. Do not make this easier for me.
leaders.win: Take the seal. I will think about what it signs.
leaders.lose: Normal is a fine thing to be. Remember that.
leaders.badgeStory: the Plain Seal is the League stamp with no flourish, as a reminder.
leaders.conflict: Is the League's public face and suspects the Gilt Circle
leaders.hook: League Meeting; a quiet admission late in the run

leaders.name: Ottilie Brandt

scene.title: The Price of Power
scene.setting: a Cogwell turbine hall, brass pipes ringing, a locked door marked "Combine".
lines: "Progress costs something. I decided early that it was somebody else's something."
"I consult for people you don't like. I tell myself it's research."
"Look at the turbine. Beautiful. It cools with the Veinheart seam. Does that bother you?"

choices.label: Say yes, it bothers you
choices.outcome: Respect +6; she asks to see the mine; the Price of Power theme advances

choices.label: Ask who she consults for
choices.outcome: Trust +8; she names Director Pym

choices.label: Admire the turbine
choices.outcome: Affection +5; you hear only the surface

leaders.pre: Progress requires sacrifice. I volunteer other people.
leaders.mid: That was not a sacrifice. That was a gift.
leaders.win: Take the gear. Count what it cost.
leaders.lose: The system holds. Don't mistake it for kind.
leaders.badgeStory: the Tithe Gear is the gear she keeps for what each machine costs.
leaders.conflict: Quietly consults for the Ironvein Combine
leaders.hook: A factory event; The Price of Power themes

leaders.name: Maren Ashcroft

scene.title: The Rivalry Between Leaders
scene.setting: a Cogwell forge yard, a letter in her fist, steam rising.
lines: "Tolliver. Always Tolliver. We had the same teacher and he thinks I stole the lesson."
"I'm not angry. I'm precise. Ask Magmortar."
"Carry this to him? Or tell him I said he can stop pretending."

choices.label: Carry the letter
choices.outcome: Trust +10 kept; Tolliver reacts later (ripple)

choices.label: Mediate: soften the letter
choices.outcome: Respect +6; Maren's feud softens a notch

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: Trust -3

leaders.pre: I trained under the same hand as Tolliver. I do it better.
leaders.mid: Oh. You can take a hit. Good.
leaders.win: Take the badge. Don't tell Tolliver I said you were good.
leaders.lose: Burn, then. And come back warmer.
leaders.badgeStory: the Ember Rule is a coal that never goes out, because her teacher said so.
leaders.conflict: Trained under the same teacher as Tolliver and resents his approach

leaders.name: Hesper Dunmore

scene.title: The Unusual Migration
scene.setting: a Halvard Row garden at dusk, a moth swarm drifting the wrong way.
lines: "Volcarona leads them. It has never come this way."
"The forests are thinner. They are looking for a new home."
"I would hold them. I would hold all of them. I can't."

choices.label: Walk the migration with her
choices.outcome: Trust +10, Affection +6; a Viridian theme tie-in event

choices.label: Take notes for the Lore Archive
choices.outcome: Respect +6; a Lore entry

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.outcome: Trust -3

leaders.win: A chrysalis for you. It means a change is coming.
leaders.badgeStory: the Chrysalis is a husk she kept from the first moth she raised.

leaders.name: Bramble Quisby

scene.title: The Succession
scene.setting: a Halvard Row greenhouse, a chessboard by the window, a letter from Tolliver.
lines: "Check. He plays chess like he sails. Rudely."
"I want an heir who loves plants more than winning. They are rarer than Legendaries."
"Plant this seed. If it lives, I'll consider you."

choices.label: Plant the seed and promise to check on it
choices.outcome: Trust +10 kept; the seed grows into an item later

choices.label: Ask about Tolliver
choices.outcome: Trust +8; the chess pact is revealed

choices.label: Decline
choices.outcome: No change

leaders.win: Take the heartwood. It is slow. So is everything good.
leaders.badgeStory: the Heartwood is a cut of Torterra's oldest branch.
leaders.conflict: Wants an heir who loves plants more than winning
leaders.hook: Succession event; chess pact with Tolliver

elite.name: Isadora Voll
elite.visual: Tall, stooped; dusk-violet robe with silver index tabs; a chained book; a faded blue ribbon
elite.personality: Dry, gentle, exact. Habit: ends with "for the record"
elite.motivation: Now: collect every challenger's story. Underneath: finish her sister's, lost in the Cairnmoor mist
elite.strategy: Status and stall: Will-O-Wisp, Toxic, Substitute, Pain Split
elite.ace: Ace Spiritomb "Index", rumored to hold 108 names
elite.relationships: Prosper Lund (borrows his maps), Brigid Tamsin (shares a table), Maelis Ravenscar (was once her reader)
elite.history: Librarian at the League; her sister vanished in the mist 20 years ago; she became an Elite 11 years ago
elite.conflict: Writes everyone else's story, cannot write her own
elite.arc: Start: shelves. End: tells the story of the ribbon
elite.independent: Writes one challenger's story into the Lore Archive each night, win or lose

elite.name: Kofi Adeyemi
elite.visual: Broad, compact; slate vest; wrapped forearms; stopwatch and rolled chart
elite.personality: Calm, hard, fair. Habit: counts out loud
elite.motivation: Now: finish the teaching he started with Hale. Underneath: be forgiven for a student he pushed too far
elite.ace: Ace Lucario "Tempo", who learned patience before speed
elite.relationships: Hale Brightwater (former pupil), Tam Rourke (old sparring partner), Selene (respects her calm)
elite.history: Coached Hale at 12; trained under Tam; became an Elite after 4 Gym titles
elite.conflict: Believes in discipline but fears he broke someone with it
elite.arc: Start: drills. End: he lets someone win a drill
elite.independent: Posts a daily training chart on the League board

elite.name: Brigid Tamsin
elite.visual: Tall; silver braid to the waist; pale-blue oilskin; seal-fur collar
elite.personality: Quiet, unflappable, patient. Habit: speaks in tide times
elite.motivation: Now: keep the storm flags honest. Underneath: hear Brinecrown speak once more
elite.strategy: Weather: snow then rain, with Ice and Water pairs
elite.ace: Ace Lapras "Halyard", who carried her out of a wreck
elite.relationships: Captain Tolliver Brisk (taught her knots), Isadora Voll, Aurelio Santos
elite.history: Born on Tidewrack; her father drowned in a storm of broken oaths; she joined the League at 22
elite.conflict: Hates storms and calls herself their guardian
elite.arc: Start: watching the sea. End: she leaves the flag lowered for a day
elite.independent: Walks the quay at every low tide and logs the weather

elite.name: Aurelio Santos
elite.visual: Dragon-tamer coat, formal collar; a scale pin; neat gloves
elite.personality: Reserved, formal, courteous. Habit: bows slightly before every sentence
elite.motivation: Now: guard the last gate fairly. Underneath: avoid answering what he knows about Equinar
elite.strategy: Setup sweep: Dragon Dance, then sweep
elite.relationships: Rhodri Vale (shared dragon lore), Selene Aurelian (his Champion), Gideon Hartwell (old friend)
elite.history: Dragon-tamer family; saw Equinar's tremor in the hills; joined the League 10 years ago
elite.conflict: Sworn to honesty, bound to silence
elite.arc: Start: formal. End: can be a story ally if Trust is 75 or higher
elite.independent: Checks the League's last gate each dusk, in person

champion.name: Selene Aurelian
champion.visual: Poised; high braided crown with a copper clasp; cream half-cape; star-ring collar
champion.personality: Calm, precise, kind. Habit: pauses before answering
champion.motivation: Now: hold the title honestly. Underneath: be more than Gideon's student
champion.strategy: Counters the player's recent types; adapts one slot after 3 fights
champion.relationships: Gideon Hartwell (mentor), Kofi (respect), Cornelius Ashdown (the title's history)
champion.history: Student of Gideon; won the title at 27; has defended it for 7 years
champion.conflict: Wants to be a Champion who is chosen, not inherited
champion.arc: Start: guarded. End: names the player's Starter in her intro (Bond Level 6)
champion.independent: Reviews every Gym result each week and writes a note to each Leader

ashdown.name: Cornelius Ashdown
ashdown.visual: Gaunt, gold-trimmed navy suit; cracked-laurel pin; old half-cape re-cut as a scarf
ashdown.personality: Bitter, brilliant, proud. Habit: "once upon a time" before every threat
ashdown.motivation: Now: control Championship outcomes. Underneath: be written back into the lobby
ashdown.strategy: Showy, high pressure, with items and legal-edge tactics
ashdown.relationships: Gideon Hartwell (rival who replaced him), Piers Dunne (fixer), Gaspard Orme (once his protege)
ashdown.history: Champion for 12 years; removed from the lobby wall; founded the Gilt Circle
ashdown.conflict: Wants honest greatness and cheats to get it
ashdown.arc: Start: polite. End: a recognition scene or a public exposure
ashdown.independent: Pays for one rigged bracket each season

teamLeaders.name: Maelis Ravenscar
teamLeaders.title: Cantor
teamLeaders.scene: The Silent Bell: she lifts the muffled clapper

teamLeaders.name: Leocadia Strand
teamLeaders.title: Chairwoman
teamLeaders.scene: The Boardroom: she prices a Pokémon
teamLeaders.turn: No, but a leak ends her

teamLeaders.name: Anselm Rook
teamLeaders.title: Surveyor
teamLeaders.scene: The Unfound: a tour of the ship

teamLeaders.name: Thessaly Greaves
teamLeaders.scene: The Manifesto: she reads one burn-edged page

lieutenants.name: Brother Cull
lieutenants.motivation: Protect the Cantor; afraid of loud places
lieutenants.scene: Mallet Night: he rings a muffled bell for a lost friend

lieutenants.name: Sister Pennant
lieutenants.motivation: Quiet, so the world heals; she misses the patients
lieutenants.scene: The Cloth Bell: she shows what silence costs

lieutenants.name: Alaric Pym
lieutenants.scene: Quarterly Review: he reads a memo aloud

lieutenants.name: Brook Ealing
lieutenants.motivation: Keep a job; miss the forest in the photo
lieutenants.scene: The Photo: he shows the cap-band forest
lieutenants.turn: Yes, if the player speaks for the forest

lieutenants.name: Bettina Quay
lieutenants.motivation: The thrill of a find; guilt about relics
lieutenants.scene: Relic Return: she is asked to return a stolen tablet

lieutenants.name: Corwin Tace
lieutenants.scene: The Sextant: he teaches the player to read a chart

lieutenants.name: Joss Marden
lieutenants.scene: Short Circuit: a sabotage run on a pylon
lieutenants.turn: Yes, if civilians are at risk

lieutenants.name: Pilar Okafor
lieutenants.scene: The Armband: she treats a hurt grunt

lieutenants.name: Lucia Ferrante
lieutenants.motivation: Win clean in her own books
lieutenants.scene: The Odds: she offers odds on the player
lieutenants.turn: Maybe, if the fix is exposed

lieutenants.name: Piers Dunne
lieutenants.scene: The Coin: he flips it when he lies

grunts.line: You wore a coat like this once. Do not pretend otherwise.
The Architect says a Champion's heir is just a very polite subject.
You hear them, don't you? The Ascension needs someone who hears.
Subject, there is a number on your wrist. We have the same number.
Old history, new coat. We would rather borrow your past than ask.
A new badge. The Hounds will have your Dratini by evening.
Rest if you like. The Chalk will take notes on how you rest.
You met a coat of ours. We heard. You were polite. We noticed.
You know the quiet of a hideout. Come, listen again.
A Champion shouts. We have stopped shouting.
The forest does not shout either. You already know.
You were made in a loud room. Come, we will be quiet.
You have walked in the long night. You remember it.
A badge rings. Quiet it.
Your friends are tired. Rest here, in the bell's shadow.
Sister Pennant spoke of you. She was gentle. I am not.
Used to run for a living? We pay overtime.
A famous name looks good on a pay stub.
Greenwall is a tidy job, kid. Trees fall, jobs grow.
You are a prototype. We love prototypes.
Old relics, old mines. We bring them up to date.
Another badge? The Chairwoman prices badges too.
Your team's low. That is a procurement issue.
Pym says you read memos. Please don't read this one.
A thief sees a map and thinks of a vault. Good instinct.
A name, like a coastline, is only useful once charted.
Your forest is on the survey. Do not take it personally.
You are an uncharted subject. The Surveyor will be thrilled.
The Survey Corps maps are ours now. We are honoring them.
Another badge. Another pin on the map.
Do rest. We can chart your route while you do.
Bettina said you were polite. We take that as a bearing.
We know. Everyone in the grid knows. We still want you.
A Champion's heir? Then you know the cage best.
You hear the forest! Help us burn the pylons that choke it!
They kept you in a cage. We open cages.
In your day there was no grid. We want that day back.
More badges means more lamps. More lamps means more wire.
Pilar's tent is open. Patch up, then fight.
Joss said you were fun. He lies. Let's find out.
You know how a fix works. Join the ledger.
Mr. Ashdown remembers Hartwell. He will remember you.
Nice forest. Hope it isn't on the bracket.
The League measures talent. We simply measure it better.
Old rules, new odds. We keep the books honest. Mostly.
A new badge? The odds just shifted.
A tired team makes a poor bet. We'll cover it.
Lucia has you at three to one. She's rarely wrong.
